meta.title: AI travel guide
meta.description: Ask our AI travel guide about itineraries, hotels, restaurants, trains and flights, culture, phrases and budgets across Uzbekistan.

hero.title: Your personal guide to Uzbekistan, in your pocket
hero.lead: Ask anything: where to stay and eat, how to get from city to city, what to see nearby, how to say thank you in Uzbek, or how much your trip will cost. Answers come from our own catalogue of tours, hotels, restaurants and transport.

chat.title: Gulistan Travel guide
chat.subtitle: Itineraries, stays, food, transport and culture
chat.welcome: Hello! I'm your Gulistan Travel travel guide. Tell me where you'd like to go, or pick a question below.
chat.placeholder: Ask about hotels, trains, food, culture…
chat.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
chat.limited: Too many messages in a minute. Please wait a moment.
chat.consent: Remember this chat on this device
chat.disclaimer: The guide can make mistakes. Prices are indicative and times are typical; our travel manager confirms rooms, seats and the final price.
chat.bookBody: {title} · {adults} adults{children}. Our team replies within 24 hours. This is not a confirmed booking yet.
